item.title: (Solved) EditForm requires either a Model parameter or an EditContext parameter
item.description: Summary In this article, we will explore how to resolve the Blazor Server error: EditForm requires either a Model parameter, or an EditContext parameter. We’ll go through a step-by-step explanation of the code, practical examples, and alternative methods to achieve the same functionality. Understanding the Error The error EditForm requires either a Model parameter, or an EditContext parameter occurs when Blazor’s EditForm component is not provided with the required parameters for model binding.
